title: Köthe Conjecture
exact_target: Must a ring with no nonzero nil two-sided ideal also have no nonzero nil one-sided ideal? The question concerns arbitrary associative rings, including rings without an identity.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1455 (ALG-010). CC BY 4.0.
Peter Kálnai and Jan Žemlička, Self-Injective von Neumann Regular Rings and Köthe’s Conjecture, arXiv:1912.12159v2 (2020), opening paragraphs and definitions on page 1.
